resources.string: Call screening can be silently killed

Some phones aggressively kill background apps, which can stop calls from being screened at all. This app has no persistent background process; it just needs the system to be allowed to wake it briefly per call.
Exempt from battery optimization
Always allow
Calls that match any of these are let through before anything is blocked.
Contacts
Allow calls from anyone in your contacts
Recently answered
Allow people you answered a call from lately
Allow again for
Recently called
Allow numbers you called lately, such as a callback
Allow for
Blocking
What happens to calls that no allow rule lets through.
Reject unknown numbers
Block numbers that are not in your contacts or on your allow list
When a call is blocked
Applies to your block list and, if enabled above, unknown numbers.
Silence
Reject
Shown silently. You can still answer it, but it never rings.
Rejected outright. It never appears as an incoming call.
Notify when a call is rejected
Show a heads-up notification for each rejected call
Your lists
Numbers you added by hand. These are checked first: a number on your block list is blocked even if it is also a contact.
People you know
Let through callers you already have a relationship with. If any of these match, the call rings normally.
Unknown callers
Decide what happens to a number that none of the rules above recognised.
When a call is blocked
Choose how a blocked call reaches you. It always stays visible in the Recent tab.
Block list
Numbers you chose to block. This rule runs first and always wins.
You blocked a telemarketer. They are blocked even if you later save them as a contact.
Allow list
Numbers you always want to hear from. They are let through unless they are on the block list.
Your pharmacy is not in your contacts, but you want their calls to ring.
Caller name pattern
Allows calls whose caller ID name matches a pattern you set. It only works when the carrier sends a name.
A pattern like "Dr." lets through any call whose caller ID starts with "Dr.".
Contacts
Allows anyone saved in your contacts.
Your sister calls from her saved number. It rings normally.
Recently answered
Allows a number again for a while after you answered a call from it.
You answered a delivery driver yesterday. Their call back today rings.
Recently called
Allows numbers you called yourself for a while, so a callback is not blocked.
You phoned a clinic this morning. When they call back this afternoon, it rings.
Unknown numbers
The last rule. A number that matched nothing above is allowed, or blocked if you turn this on.
An unsaved number you never contacted calls. With this on, it is blocked.
Appearance
Dynamic color
Theme the app from your wallpaper instead of the brand palette
